body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> EnGIS introduced its real 3D navigation map software 'Gogo3D' during CES 2009, which features TMC(Traffic Message Channel) and TTS(Text to Speech) functions.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
